name: Thank you for your first visit
description: Sent within a week of a new client's first appointment. The single highest-value card: it turns a first visit into a second one and is the most natural moment to ask for a review.
guidelines: Thank them for choosing CF Hair Salon for their first visit. Mention the service they had and that it was a pleasure for their stylist to meet them. If there is a client note, use one small detail naturally. Invite them back warmly without pushing a booking. You may add one gentle line that a Google review helps a small neighbourhood salon, phrased as a favour, never as a demand.
